decisions: Append the current official SBI VC Trade product-page terms without overwriting the earlier launch snapshot.
Separate base monthly reward conversion from the September–December 2026 promotional campaign.
Record the application window as open at the capture time and ending 2026-10-31; card issuance by 2026-11-30; spend through 2026-12-05; rewards by end-February 2027.
Treat SBI VC Trade's displayed sales price at 06:59:59 on the prior day as a reward-conversion reference, not a market execution record.
Keep XRP reward units, XRP selection share, inventory source, spot/OTC purchases and net external capital unknown.
Do not admit the program as a directional XRP price feature.
required_verification: Observe whether current campaign card applications and reward credits are reported in official aggregate data.
Obtain XRP-specific reward units and settlement sourcing if publicly disclosed.
Check current Aplus terms for changes after the product-page capture.
